providers.title: Geometric and uniform times
providers.scope: For a stationary chain and data in any metric space, the mean squared displacement at an independent geometric time of mean t is at most 28 times its average over the times 1, ..., t.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Cut representation
providers.scope: Finitely many points of l1 are T(z_i) for binary vectors z_i with ||x_i - x_j||_1 = ||z_i - z_j||_(1,w) = ||z_i - z_j||_H^2, where T is affine and 1-Lipschitz from the weighted l1 norm into l1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Flatness of the cubic (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The squared weighted l1 increment of the coordinatewise cubic 3r^2 - 2r^3 is at most 108 times the second-order remainder of the fourth-power potential centred at a binary vector.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Telescoping along a harmonic function
providers.scope: Along a harmonic function of a finite Markov chain, the expected squared increments after the cubic are at most 108 times the increase of the fourth-power potential.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The jump identity
providers.scope: For the walk killed with probability 1/(t+1), the expected squared jumps after the cubic add up to B + t E_A.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The terminal cost
providers.scope: B + t E_A is at most 108 times the mean squared l1 displacement of the data at the killing time.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Metric Markov cotype two of l1 (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The cotype inequality holds in l1 with C^2 = 3024 for every stochastic matrix and stationary vector.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Expected medians (OpenAI)
providers.scope: The new point at i is the expected coordinatewise median of the data at three independent stopped-walk endpoints from i.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Complex scalars
providers.scope: The complex space l1 has metric Markov cotype two with constant at most 12 sqrt(42).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
